name: オフライン保存済み資料行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lighthouse component catalog LH15-0002, one offline-saved file row.
Primary request: Redesign this actual row with original-reference quality icons, locked Japanese copy and the official white Lighthouse system.
Reference hierarchy: Image 1 ORIGINAL Google Drive screenshot is PRIMARY authority for icon geometry, optical weight, spacing and small control details. Focus only on its To-do list row at source pixels x47 y458 w1096 h189. Recover the recognizable original green spreadsheet artwork and the gray round offline check symbol with its small bottom stroke, plus three horizontal overflow dots. Preserve the original artwork's color. Image 2 is OUR SECONDARY FigCraft mock: use its exact Japanese content, row arrangement and text roles, but correct its rough blank-page substitute icon and featureless green status dot using image 1. Image 3 approved bus image supplies white-surface/soft-depth craft only; borrow no bus content.
Exact visible copy, no other text: "持ち物の確認表" on line one; "更新 5:01" on line two after the small offline-saved indicator.
Typography at logical scale: Meiryo Regular 14/24 px title, Meiryo Regular 12/16 px metadata, letter spacing0. Do not make all text bold. Uniform output scaling allowed, preserve hierarchy and wrapping.
Layout: One compact horizontal row approximately 390x64 logical px. Document/spreadsheet artwork left; two-line text center; offline check immediately before metadata; three-dot overflow far right, vertically centered. No extra heading, chip label, action, rows, counters or invented features. Show complete component on white canvas with modest margins and readable details.
Materials: #FFFFFF canvas and row, fine neutral outline, restrained rounded corners and very soft downward shadow. Main text #1D1D1D, metadata #6E6E6E, utility dots and saved-state glyph #526173. Crisp glyph proportions like original. No tinted icon tiles, broad mint fills, glow or exaggerated gloss.
Accent decision: The source green spreadsheet icon identifies original file-type artwork; retain it consistently. Offline check has real saved-state meaning and remains neutral slate as in original. Omit decorative green status dot from mock. There is no primary CTA, so do not invent a green button or gradient. This is a saved file, no selected/focused treatment.
Constraints: Original icon/detail decisions override the rough mock. Preserve all actual content and controls, Japanese wording and numerals. No English, source page navigation, Google/Mobbin watermark, ID, captions, device frame or design-board text. Static design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原図を優先して自作の粗い白紙ベクトルと単なる緑点を置換。原図の緑の表アイコン、横三点、下線付きオフラインチェックを復元。生成を目視確認：持ち物の確認表／更新 5:01が読め、状態と操作の欠落なし。白面・中立の枠と影。厳密なMeiryoメトリクスは未証明、所有者承認・ネイティブ編集性・実装未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
